title: Who holds the lottery ticket?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the selling and buying roles for the same object.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the selling and buying roles for the same object affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Ratio, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the selling and buying roles for the same object in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy seller asks 15; a buyer offers 5 for the same item. What is the sell-to-buy ratio?
